faq.q: Is PUBG Mobile safe for kids?
faq.a: Google Play rates PUBG Mobile Teen. It has realistic shooting and voice chat with strangers, so younger children should play with chat off and with parental controls on spending.
Version 4.7 adds the Arctic Chronicles themed mode, Erangel Subzero, a new PvE mode, WOW Brainrot snowy gameplay, basic experience improvements and a Bentley supercar collaboration.

faq.q: Why is PUBG Mobile banned in India?
faq.a: PUBG Mobile was banned in India in 2020. Players in India use Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI), a separate KRAFTON game with its own Play listing.

faq.q: PUBG Mobile vs Free Fire: which needs a better phone?
faq.a: PUBG Mobile needs a stronger phone for smooth play, with more storage and RAM. Free Fire is lighter and runs well on low-cost phones.
